## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      5 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 12 sept. 2026 - 15 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Hi A_, 13 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Disappointing UI, broken AI Messy Interface: hard to navigate and doesn't even let you choose preferred units (kg/lb), forcing every unit option on screen at once. Inaccurate Food Scanner: Logging 65g of meat showed up as 100g of fish. Three other 4.5+ star apps got it 100% right on the first try. Billing Issues: Charged my card after I already canceled the subscription. Save your money, PRO is a waste, actually the app is pointless there is soooo much better options. Run until you can"
            2. _John Rinehart_, 15 sept. 2026, 3/5: "great tool for tracking your daily habits and is fairly accurate considering these kinds of apps are notoriously unreliable I've used it to go into a calorie deficit for fat loss and recently changed goals to maintenance as I learn things about my own metabolism. the suggested macros and caloric intake has been pretty good. however there are some basic functions that are behind a paywall, a paywall that didn't exist 4 yrs ago. greed doesn't look good on anyone."
            3. _Cari Cruse_, 13 sept. 2026, 3/5: "Feature Request: It would be so helpful when scrolling down our Diary if the calories (& macros) were pinned at the top. Also, please make the selected day more obvious at the top, it's too easy to enter things on the wrong day. || Cancelled Premium! New UI is horrible mess. Have used MFP 13 years."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 sept. 2026 - 10 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Natalie Kirk_, 10 sept. 2026, 4/5: "It's been good. Except today, it has started showing me ads with music! On my food journal entry log! Specifically Candy Crush ads with no option to mute them!!! PLEASE REMOVE ADS WITH SOUND. I DO NOT WANT BAD MUSIC BLASTING FOR EVERYONE TO HEAR WHILE I'M AT A CAFÉ ENTERING MY LUNCH!!!!!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 6 mai 2026 - 14 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Jonathan_, 14 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I used it before and worked great but now I can't log my foods. when I try to add anything just freezes. I've uninstall and reinstall many times but everytime it freezes."
            2. _enka cacka_, 21 août 2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Ein Google-Nutzer_, 16 août 2026, 1/5: "Demands an insane amount of access to your personal data. Also, the amount of ads has increased to a level that makes the app unusable."
<!--/ir-theme-->
